title: MindPets Announces Upcoming Launch of Smart AI Collar on Indiegogo: GPS Tracking, Health Monitoring, and Two-Way Communication for Pets | User | bigspringherald.com
text:
MindPets launches Smart AI Collar on Indiegogo, featuring GPS tracking, satellite positioning, health monitoring, and two-way communication with pets MindPets announces the upcoming launch of its Smart AI Collar on Indiegogo, introducing the world’s first pet collar to feature satellite positioning, AI-driven health monitoring, and real-time two-way communication between humans and pets. Interested backers can now sign up to receive a 40% early-bird discount when the campaign goes live.
A dog equipped with the MindPets Smart AI Collar, featuring GPS tracking, satellite positioning, health monitoring, and two-way communication, explores safely off-leash
Powered by a next-generation Qualcomm chip, the Smart AI Collar offers GPS and satellite positioning technology that delivers 300% more accurate tracking than conventional pet trackers. This enhanced precision helps pet owners locate their animals faster and more reliably, reducing the risk of a lost pet turning into a stray animal.
A cat wearing the MindPets Smart AI Collar with GPS tracking, satellite positioning, health monitoring, and two-way communication safely explores off-leash
Beyond tracking, the collar introduces AI-based health monitoring that continuously measures key wellness indicators, including movement, sleep, and behavior patterns. This data empowers pet owners to spot early signs of health issues and support proactive care.
A key innovation is the collar’s AI-powered human-pet 2way communication system. Using a multimodal translation model, it interprets barking and physical cues into understandable messages, while also allowing pet owners to send translated voice cues back to their pets. This bidirectional system strengthens the human-animal bond and helps minimize misunderstandings between pets and their owners.
The MindPets Smart AI Collar is designed for those who want to keep their pets safe, healthy, and understood—whether it's through tracking a lost pet, preventing illness, or communicating more clearly.
The product will be officially launched on Indiegogo , with early supporters receiving 40% off by signing up in advance.
About MindPets
MindPets is a technology company focused on advancing everyday pet care through AI-powered innovation. With a mission to enhance safety, wellness, and communication between pets and their owners, MindPets creates tools that bring peace of mind and deeper connection to pet families around the world.
